sections.heading: Puducherry's Industrial Estates: Mettupalayam, Sedarapet and Thirubuvanai
paragraphs: Industrial estates in the Union Territory of Puducherry are run by PIPDIC. Its own listings describe Mettupalayam as the largest, at around 167 acres with some 257 units, followed by Sedarapet with around 83 units; Thirubuvanai has an electronics focus. Pharmaceutical formulation is a significant part of the base - filings before the National Green Tribunal by the Puducherry Pollution Control Committee list several formulation units in the PIPDIC estate at Mettupalayam, and further formulation plants operate around Thirubuvanai.
Puducherry's formulators are mostly small and mid-sized, many with WHO-GMP certification, which sets the tone for what they buy.

sections.heading: WHO-GMP Formulators: Getting the Purified-Water System Right
paragraphs: For a mid-sized formulation plant the purified-water system is the single most inspected utility. Build it in 316L from the RO permeate onward. An ambient loop in SF1 mechanically polished tube is usually defensible for oral solids; move to SF4 electropolished tube for hot-sanitised loops, for liquid orals and for points of use that feed product directly. Slope every line to drain, keep dead legs within ASME BPE guidance, and passivate after welding.

Every lot we supply carries an EN 10204 3.1 certificate traced to heat number, a PMI record for each length and, for electropolished tube, an internal Ra report - the material evidence a WHO-GMP inspector expects to see in the water-system qualification file.

sections.heading: Pharmaceutical Effluent Under Review
paragraphs: The National Green Tribunal has taken up the environmental impact of pharmaceutical manufacturing in a case that includes Puducherry, with the territory's pollution control committee filing details of formulation units. Units under that scrutiny benefit from product-contact and CIP lines that clean in fewer, shorter cycles, reducing wash-water and detergent load to treatment.

sections.heading: Engineering and Food Units
paragraphs: Engineering units in Puducherry's estates need tube to drawing with certificates they can pass on to food or pharma end users. Food units need sanitary product and CIP lines - 304 for most duty, 316L for salty or acidic products - with electropolishing reserved for lines cleaned between every batch. Electronics units at Thirubuvanai need high-purity water lines only where their process demands it; tell us the water specification and we will advise the finish.

sections.heading: Solara's Ibuprofen API Plant in Puducherry
paragraphs: Alongside the formulators, Puducherry has an active pharmaceutical ingredient plant: Solara Active Pharma Sciences runs a facility dedicated to ibuprofen and its derivatives. The US FDA made an unannounced inspection there from 2 to 6 February 2026 and issued four Form 483 observations, which the company describes as procedural. In April 2026 Solara reported that the agency had issued an Establishment Inspection Report classifying the inspection Voluntary Action Indicated and closing it.

An API plant uses stainless tube differently from a tablet plant. Reaction and solvent sections are a corrosion and pressure question, usually answered with pickled 316L pipe. Electropolished 316L tube earns its cost after the final purification step: transfer of the crystallised product, centrifuge and dryer feed lines, purified-water supply to final washes, and sampling points, where a smooth, crevice-free bore drains completely and shows any residue during visual inspection after cleaning.

sections.heading: What a Puducherry Buyer Should Put in an RFQ
bullets: The estate (Mettupalayam, Sedarapet, Thirubuvanai or elsewhere) and whether the plant makes formulations or an API.
For WHO-GMP formulators: the purified-water loop temperature and sanitisation method, which decides between SF1 and SF4.
For API lines: which lines sit before and after the final purification step, so electropolished tube goes only where it is needed.
For food units: the product and its salt or acid content, which decides between 304 and 316L.
Sizes as OD x wall to ASME BPE or ASTM A270, or pipe to ASTM A312. We quote within 24 hours, and delivery time is confirmed with the quotation.

sections.heading: Delivery to Puducherry
paragraphs: Puducherry is supplied by road from Mumbai; dispatch and transit are confirmed in writing with each quotation. Chennai Port, about 160 km away, is the nearest listed sea gateway for export-bound material.
